description: Land Acquisition - Orr's Hill, Trincomalee Town & Gravets D/S  Division, Trincomalee District and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2010/29 of D/S Division, Laggala-Pallegama
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily focused on land acquisition matters. It contains notices under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act describing specific land parcels to be acquired for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of land boundaries, lot numbers, and extents. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
